name: Dr. Kavitha Sundaram
title: Head of Mathematics & Biology
bio: Dr. Kavitha holds a Ph.D. in Applied Mathematics from IISc Bangalore and has 15 years of teaching experience. Her innovative visual teaching methods have helped over 5,000 students crack JEE and NEET. She believes every Indian student deserves world-class math education.

name: Prof. Rajesh Iyer
title: Senior Physics Faculty
bio: Professor Iyer is an IIT Bombay alumnus who worked at ISRO for 10 years before joining PrismTutor Studio. His ability to explain complex physics through everyday Indian examples and virtual experiments makes him one of the most sought-after JEE physics teachers in the country.

name: Dr. Meera Nair
title: Chemistry Department Head
bio: Dr. Nair's passion for chemistry is infectious. With a Ph.D. from IIT Delhi and experience in pharmaceutical research at Dr. Reddy's Labs, she brings real-world applications into every lesson. Her 3D molecular modeling sessions are legendary among NEET aspirants.

name: Ms. Anjali Deshmukh
title: English & Humanities Faculty
bio: Anjali is a JNU alumna, published author, and former journalist who brings storytelling into education. Her creative writing workshops have produced national-level award-winning student writers, and her literature classes are known for lively debates and deep analysis of Indian and world literature.

name: Mr. Vikram Malhotra
title: Computer Science & Math Faculty
bio: Vikram transitioned from a successful career at Infosys and Microsoft India to teaching the next generation of programmers. An IIT Kanpur alumnus, he combines industry experience with academic rigor to create courses aligned with CBSE Computer Science and competitive programming.
